vulnerabilities.summary: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
vulnerabilities.plainEnglish: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources. This affects js-yaml 4.1.1. Upgrade to 4.3.2 or later to fix it.

vulnerabilities.summary: js-yaml: YAML merge-key chains can force quadratic CPU consumption
vulnerabilities.plainEnglish: js-yaml: YAML merge-key chains can force quadratic CPU consumption. This affects js-yaml 4.1.1. Upgrade to 3.15.0 or later to fix it.
